adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions because primary XML/PDF text supports DptB and GNBP-like3 bacterial-growth OD600 activity, APD6 database rows are reconciled as caution-bearing source_conflict rather than over-promoted source_verified records, and mechanism claims are bounded to growth attenuation plus unresolved molecular mechanism limits.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/figure captions/supplementary spreadsheet parses/OA package/database rows were sufficient to close the rework ticket. Remaining exact species, exact full primary-source sequences, and Fig 6B colony counts are explicitly nonblocking source limitations, not fabricated values.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP03032/AP03033 are not source_verified because local primary material does not embed exact full sequences and does not support a broad Anti-Gram+ & Gram- panel. The paper does support names, lengths, Drosophila source context, citation, and bacteriostatic activity, so both rows are retained as source_conflict with locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary text/Fig 6 supports DptB and GNBP-like3 OD600-after-22h bacterial-growth records and a qualitative DptB plate-growth inhibition record. The paper has no MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity table; organism and exact Fig 6B counts remain explicit nonblocking source gaps.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: The source supports bacteriostatic growth attenuation and memory-function context. No molecular antimicrobial mechanism such as membrane disruption or cell-wall targeting is promoted because it is not assayed in the local material.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The previous blocking reasons are resolved by source-reviewed artifacts and no open rework target remains. Remaining limitations are caution-level and explicitly preserved.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 and merged sequence exports contain exact AP03032/AP03033 sequences, but the reviewed primary paper material supports names/lengths rather than embedding the full sequences.
APD6 records Anti-Gram+ & Gram-, while the primary paper reports bacterial growth attenuation without an organism-resolved Gram-positive/Gram-negative panel.
The antimicrobial activity section describes bacteria carrying expression constructs but does not name the bacterial species or strain.
The paper supports growth attenuation and memory phenotypes, but not MIC/MBC values or a specific molecular antimicrobial mechanism.
